tijdlijn.beschrijving: An overview of what needs to be arranged and when after a death. Use this checklist as a guide for your next of kin. The exact order may vary per situation.
tijdlijn.disclaimer: Note: This overview is informational and not legal advice. The deadlines and obligations may vary per situation. Always consult a notary or legal advisor for your specific situation.

huisarts.titel: Call the GP or attending physician
huisarts.beschrijving: The doctor establishes death and issues a death certificate. Without this certificate, the funeral cannot be arranged.

uitvaart.beschrijving: Contact the funeral director or insurance. They will guide the further procedure and arrange transport.

naasten.titel: Inform next of kin and emergency contacts
naasten.beschrijving: Notify immediate family members, emergency contacts and, if applicable, the employer.

donor.beschrijving: Check as soon as possible whether there is a donor registration. Speed is essential for organ donation.

wilsverklaring.beschrijving: If applicable: check whether an advance directive or treatment prohibition has been recorded.

notaris.beschrijving: The notary opens the will and informs about the heirs, the executor and any legacies.

werkgever.beschrijving: Report the death to the employer. Discuss any entitlement to survivor's pension and holiday pay.

aangifte.beschrijving: Register the death within 6 working days at the civil registry of the municipality where the death occurred.

documenten.beschrijving: Collect the ID, marriage certificate, policies, will and bank statements.

verzekeringen.beschrijving: Report the death to all insurance companies: health insurance, life insurance, household, liability, term life.

bank.beschrijving: Inform the bank. Accounts are transferred to the heirs' names. Arrange payment orders and possibly an escrow account for the estate.

abonnementen.beschrijving: Cancel phone, internet, TV subscriptions, rental or lease contracts, memberships and streaming services.

uitkeringen.beschrijving: Report the death to the SVB (state pension), UWV, municipality (social assistance) and Tax Authority (allowances).

digitaal.beschrijving: Close or transfer online accounts: email, social media, cloud storage, webshops. Check for cryptocurrency.

erfbelasting.beschrijving: File an inheritance tax return with the Tax Authority within 8 months. Start inventorying the estate in good time.

aanvaarding.beschrijving: Heirs must choose: accept outright, accept under benefit of inventory, or reject. Accepting under benefit of inventory protects against debts.

boedelverdeling.beschrijving: Inventory all assets and debts. Distribute the estate according to the will or statutory inheritance law. The executor coordinates this.

inkomstenbelasting.beschrijving: File an income tax return for the year of death (F-form). The deadline is usually before May 1 of the following year.

socialMedia.beschrijving: Delete or set memorial mode for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and other social media accounts.

afsluitInstructies.snapchat: Next of kin can submit a removal request via the support form.

afsluitInstructies.apple: Digital Legacy program or request for account closure. Apple requires a court order or death certificate.
afsluitInstructies.yahoo: Close account via next-of-kin request. Death certificate and ID required.
afsluitInstructies.ing: Contact the bank about the death. ING handles closure via branch or phone.
afsluitInstructies.rabobank: Report the death via branch or phone. Rabobank guides the settlement process.
afsluitInstructies.abnAmro: Report the death and arrange banking matters. ABN AMRO offers a dedicated bereavement team.
afsluitInstructies.sns: Report the death and have accounts settled via the branch.
afsluitInstructies.paypal: Close account after death by contacting PayPal customer service. Death certificate required.
afsluitInstructies.bolcom: Contact customer service to have the account closed.
afsluitInstructies.amazon: Close account via the support form. Next of kin must provide a death certificate.
afsluitInstructies.coolblue: Contact customer service for account removal.
afsluitInstructies.netflix: Cancel subscription and delete account via account settings or customer service.
afsluitInstructies.spotify: Close account via account settings or by contacting support.
afsluitInstructies.disney: Cancel subscription and delete account via account management.
afsluitInstructies.steam: Account transfer is officially not supported. Contact Steam Support.
afsluitInstructies.playstation: Close account via PlayStation Support. Death certificate required.
afsluitInstructies.xbox: Falls under Microsoft Next of Kin process. Close account via Microsoft Support.

nabestaanden.introTekst: Our condolences for your loss. This dashboard guides you step by step through handling the estate. Take your time — you don't have to do everything at once.
nabestaanden.gegevensInfo: All data is available in read-only mode. Use the buttons below to track what you have already handled.
nabestaanden.hulpTekst: It's normal if this feels overwhelming. Start with the urgent matters at the top and work your way down calmly. You can always come back and continue where you left off. Seek help from a notary or funeral director if that feels right.

type.beschrijving: What type of will do you have or would you like to have drawn up?
type.wettelijkKaderTekst: The Netherlands recognises the notarial will (drawn up by a notary, legally valid) and the codicil (handwritten, only for bequests of movable property). Lumio generates a draft document as preparation for your notary visit.
type.typeTooltip: A notarial will is drawn up by a notary and is legally valid. A codicil is a handwritten document that only applies to bequests of movable property (not real estate).

uitsluitingsclausule.beschrijving: An exclusion clause prevents inheritances from becoming part of a community of property in the event of divorce.
uitsluitingsclausule.aanbevolenTekst: The exclusion clause is a commonly used provision. Without this clause, the inheritance may be divided with your heir's ex-partner in the event of a divorce.
uitsluitingsclausule.label: Include exclusion clause?
uitsluitingsclausule.tooltip: An exclusion clause stipulates that what your heir inherits remains private assets. Without this clause, the inheritance may be divided with your heir's ex-partner in the event of a divorce.
uitsluitingsclausule.ja: Yes — inheritance falls outside community of property (recommended)

keuze.beschrijving: Do you want to record an advance directive for euthanasia? This is in accordance with the Termination of Life on Request and Assisted Suicide Act (Wtl).
keuze.wettelijkKaderTekst: Euthanasia is permitted in the Netherlands when all due care criteria are met, including a voluntary and well-considered request and hopeless and unbearable suffering. A written advance directive can replace the oral request.
keuze.jaWilsverklaring: Yes, I want an advance directive for euthanasia
keuze.neeGeenEuthanasie: No, I do not want euthanasia
keuze.situatiePlaceholder: Describe the situation(s) in which you would want euthanasia, e.g. in case of hopeless and unbearable suffering, advanced dementia...
keuze.situatieOngeneeslijkZiekTooltip: Terminal illness where no further recovery is possible and suffering is unbearable.
keuze.situatieErnstigLetselTooltip: E.g. serious brain injury or a condition with persistent unbearable pain.
keuze.situatiePsychiatrischLijdenTooltip: Long-term untreatable psychological suffering with no prospect of improvement.
keuze.situatieDementieVroegstadiumTooltip: Request recorded while you are still mentally competent, in case dementia progresses.
keuze.situatieAndereSituatieTooltip: Describe your personal situation in your own words.

keuze.notitiesPlaceholder: Any additional remarks about your specific situation...

dementie.beschrijving: A dementia clause specifies your wishes in the case of advanced dementia, when you may no longer be able to express your will.
dementie.letOpTekst: The dementia clause is legally complex. Physicians are not obliged to comply with it, but it does provide a clear framework for your wishes. Always discuss this with your general practitioner.
dementie.label: Include dementia clause?
dementie.tooltip: A dementia clause is a written advance directive in which you indicate under what circumstances in advanced dementia you wish euthanasia. Physicians are not obliged to comply with it, but it provides a clear framework.
dementie.ja: Yes — I want a dementia clause
dementie.toelichtingPlaceholder:
Describe at what stage of dementia you would want euthanasia, e.g.:
- When I no longer recognise my loved ones
- When I can no longer eat or drink independently
- When I need to be admitted to a nursing home

behandelverbod.beschrijving: Which medical treatments do you want to refuse if you are no longer able to decide for yourself?
behandelverbod.wettelijkKaderTekst: You have the right to refuse medical treatments. A prior written declaration to this effect is in principle respected by healthcare providers.
behandelverbod.label: Treatment prohibition
behandelverbod.tooltip: A treatment prohibition is a written declaration in which you record which medical treatments you refuse if you can no longer decide for yourself. Under the WGBO (art. 7:450 Dutch Civil Code), this is in principle respected by healthcare providers.
behandelverbod.placeholder:
Which treatments do you refuse? For example:
- Resuscitation
- Mechanical ventilation
- Artificial nutrition and hydration
- Antibiotics for life-threatening infection
- Intensive care admission

vertegenwoordiger.beschrijving: Who may speak on your behalf when you are no longer able to do so? (in accordance with WGBO art. 7:465 Dutch Civil Code)

eigenaar.voornaam: Your first name as shown on official documents.
eigenaar.tussenvoegsel: E.g., 'van', 'de'. Common in Dutch names but optional.
eigenaar.achternaam: Your last name as shown on official documents.
eigenaar.geboortedatum: Required for legal documents and inheritance tax calculations.
eigenaar.bsn: Your Citizen Service Number is stored encrypted and required for notarial deeds.
eigenaar.adres: Your residential address is used for official correspondence and documents.
eigenaar.postcode: Dutch postal codes consist of 4 digits and 2 letters (e.g., 1234 AB).
eigenaar.woonplaats: The municipality where you are registered.
eigenaar.telefoon: Optional – can be displayed on your emergency card for next of kin.
eigenaar.email: Will not be shared and serves only for your own records.
eigenaar.burgerlijkeStaat: Affects statutory inheritance rights and division of joint property.
eigenaar.huwelijksvoorwaarden: Determines how assets are divided upon death or divorce.
eigenaar.datumHuwelijk: The date of your marriage or registered partnership.
eigenaar.legitimatieSoort: The type of identification document you have.
eigenaar.documentnummer: The number on your ID – required for notarial deeds.
eigenaar.geldigTot: Important: an expired ID can cause problems with notarial matters.

notaris.naam: The full name of your notary, including any title (esq.).
notaris.kantoor: The name of the notary office where your will was drafted.
notaris.telefoon: Direct phone number for quick accessibility by next of kin.
notaris.email: Email address for correspondence about your file.
notaris.adres: Useful for next of kin who need to visit the office.

erfgenamen.voornaam: The official first name of the heir as on their ID.
erfgenamen.achternaam: The official last name – important for legal documents.
erfgenamen.tussenvoegsel: Middle name particles such as 'van', 'de' or 'van der'.
erfgenamen.relatie: The family relationship determines the inheritance tax bracket.
erfgenamen.telefoon: Phone number for contact during estate settlement.
erfgenamen.email: Email address for sending documents and emergency codes.
erfgenamen.geboortedatum: Required for determining legitimate portion and tax exemption.
erfgenamen.bsn: Stored encrypted – required for notarial deeds and tax returns.
erfgenamen.adres: The residential address is needed for official correspondence.
erfgenamen.legitimatie: Type of identification document of the heir.
erfgenamen.documentnummer: The ID document number – required for notarial deeds.
erfgenamen.bestemming: What specific assets or percentages this heir receives.

shamir.wachtwoord: Your Lumio master password is split into multiple shares.
shamir.drempel: The minimum number of heirs required to work together for access. A higher threshold is more secure but requires more coordination.

boedel.bezitCategorie: Categorize your assets for a clear distribution overview.
boedel.omschrijving: A clear description helps heirs with identification.
boedel.geschatteWaarde: An estimate is sufficient – exact valuation can be done later by heirs.
boedel.locatie: Where is this asset located? Helpful for heirs during settlement.
boedel.bestemdeErfgenaam: Who should receive this specific asset? (Optional)
boedel.vermogensSoort: Private property stays separate; joint property is divided.
boedel.kadastraalNummer: The cadastral number can be found on the deed or via kadaster.nl.
boedel.kenteken: The vehicle's license plate – found on the registration certificate.
boedel.kvkNummer: Only fill in if this asset is linked to a business.
boedel.ibanRekening: Your full IBAN number. Always starts with NL for Dutch accounts.
boedel.saldoRekening: An estimate of the current balance – does not need to be exact.
boedel.verzekeraar: The name of the insurance company.
boedel.polisnummer: Found on your policy or in your insurer's app.
boedel.verzekerdBedrag: The maximum amount that will be paid out.
boedel.begunstigde: Who receives the payout? This may differ from legal heirs.
boedel.schuldeiser: The party to whom you owe money.
boedel.referentie: Your contract number or reference with the creditor.

digitaalBezit.platformNaam: The name of the service or website (e.g., Google, Facebook, LinkedIn).
